WASHINGTON, Oct 5 (Reuters) - President Donald Trump's approval rating held at a record ‌low in recent days, as many Hispanic voters panned his job performance and planned to spurn his Republican Party in next month's midterm elections, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll completed on Monday.

The six-day poll showed 32% of Americans giving a thumbs up to Trump's presidency, unchanged from ​a September Reuters/Ipsos survey that saw the leader's rating at the lowest of his political career.
